tickets.title: Four-tier NPC framework
tickets.description: Principals (10-15), Regulars (60-100), Residents (~300), Crowd. Few and deep beats many and shallow.

tickets.title: Regular generation from settlement economy
tickets.description: Economic role drawn from the region's actual economy layer — the salt-panner exists because the axioms made salt abundant.

tickets.title: Relationship web generation
tickets.description: Three to five relationships per Regular: family, rival, creditor, lover, grudge. Load-bearing — this is what makes one death ripple.

tickets.title: Trait pool (~20) and assignment
tickets.description: Two or three per Regular, used as a dialogue selection axis.

tickets.title: Wants and fears tied to live world state
tickets.description: 'Wants her brother off the dive crews', not 'seeks adventure'.

tickets.title: Systemic dialogue selection engine
tickets.description: Select authored lines by trait x topic x relationship x world-state. Never generate dialogue text at runtime.

tickets.title: Author the dialogue line pool
tickets.description: Large tagged pool. Every line hand-written; the combination is what's unique.

tickets.title: LLM-assisted line variation at authoring time
tickets.description: Development-time accelerator producing variations on authored lines in a character's voice. Read them, keep the good ones, bake the output. Never at runtime.

tickets.title: NPC memory bound to the consequence ledger
tickets.description: Helped or harmed them, their faction, their relations; witnessed events; standing and debts. Keep it small and legible.

tickets.title: Role succession on death
tickets.description: Roles are durable, people are instances. The successor remembers how the vacancy happened. Quest binder rebinds automatically.

tickets.title: Four-state schedules with no offline simulation
tickets.description: Home, work, social, sleep by time of day. NPCs are simply where they should be when the player looks.

tickets.title: Author and cast the 10-15 Principals
tickets.description: Hand-authored voice and arcs, cast into roles by the seed. Includes synergy-specific characters.

tickets.title: Principal VO recording and integration
tickets.description: Principals only. Everyone else gets vocalisations and text.

tickets.title: NPC appearance: base set, variation, per-region tinting
tickets.description: Valleys cut off by the Unbinding should look isolated. Measure MetaHuman cost at this population count before committing.
